text: Code reviews are an essential part of the software development process. When developers review each other's code before it is merged into the main project, they can catch bugs early. This saves time and effort because problems are fixed before they become more serious. Additionally, code reviews encourage knowledge sharing. Team members learn new techniques and understand different parts of the codebase, which reduces reliance on any single person. Ultimately, this process improves overall team quality. Code written by a team is often stronger and more reliable than code written by an individual, leading to better software and a more skilled group of developers.
